```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(glmnet)
  library(ClockSHAP)
  library(reactable)
})

# Rmd-friendly verbose printing
vcat <- function(...) if (isTRUE(params$verbose)) cat(..., "\n")

set.seed(params$seed)
```

```{r}
reactable_pretty <- function(df, digits = 3) {
  df2 <- df %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., digits)))
  reactable::reactable(
    df2,
    searchable = TRUE,
    resizable = TRUE,
    striped = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 10
  )
}
```

## Load Step 1–2 outputs

```{r}
analysis_id <- paste0(params$tcga_project, "__", params$gtex_project)
proc_dir    <- file.path(here::here(params$out_root), analysis_id)
suffix      <- paste0("-", params$feature_set)

scores_gtex <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, paste0("ssgsea_scores_gtex", suffix, ".rds")))
scores_nt   <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, paste0("ssgsea_scores_nt",   suffix, ".rds")))
scores_pt   <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, paste0("ssgsea_scores_pt",   suffix, ".rds")))
metadata    <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, "sample_metadata.rds"))

clock_results <- readRDS(file.path(proc_dir, paste0("clock_and_RAA_objects", suffix, ".rds")))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rownames(metadata)))
stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_gtex) %in% rownames(metadata)))
stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_pt)   %in% rownames(metadata)))
stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_nt)   %in% rownames(metadata)))
```

## Build matrices in clock feature order

```{r}
feat <- clock_results$feature_names

# features matrices: samples × features (raw ssGSEA)
X_gtex <- t(scores_gtex[feat, , drop = FALSE])
X_pt   <- t(scores_pt  [feat, , drop = FALSE])
X_nt   <- if (ncol(scores_nt) > 0) t(scores_nt[feat, , drop = FALSE]) else matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = length(feat))

# ages aligned to rownames (sample IDs)
age_gtex <- metadata[rownames(X_gtex), "age_years"]
age_pt   <- metadata[rownames(X_pt),   "age_years"]
age_nt   <- if (nrow(X_nt) > 0) metadata[rownames(X_nt), "age_years"] else numeric()

# Drop missing GTEx ages (required to fit reference profile)
keep_g <- is.finite(age_gtex)
X_gtex <- X_gtex[keep_g, , drop = FALSE]
age_gtex <- age_gtex[keep_g]

# ClockSHAP requires `age` to be a *named* vector when `features` has rownames
age_gtex <- as.numeric(age_gtex)
names(age_gtex) <- rownames(X_gtex)

has_nat <- nrow(X_nt) >= params$min_nat
vcat("GTEx n=", nrow(X_gtex), " | PT n=", nrow(X_pt), " | NAT n=", nrow(X_nt), " | has_nat=", has_nat)
```

## Build `linear_clock` object (ClockSHAP API)

IMPORTANT: Use the **ClockSHAP-ready** parameterization saved by Step 02 (`clock_results$clock_cs`).
Do NOT re-extract `coef(enet_model)` and pass `mu/sigma`, because that mismatches scales when glmnet was fit with `standardize=TRUE`.

```{r}
# pull ClockSHAP-ready params
cs <- clock_results$clock_cs

# Ensure naming is present for safe alignment
if (is.null(names(cs$beta)))  names(cs$beta)  <- clock_results$feature_names
if (is.null(names(cs$mu)))    names(cs$mu)    <- clock_results$feature_names
if (is.null(names(cs$sigma))) names(cs$sigma) <- clock_results$feature_names

alpha_cs <- cs$alpha
beta_cs  <- cs$beta[feat]
mu       <- cs$mu[feat]
sigma    <- cs$sigma[feat]

stopifnot(all(is.finite(beta_cs)), all(is.finite(mu)), all(is.finite(sigma)))

clock <- linear_clock(
  alpha = alpha_cs,
  beta  = beta_cs,
  mu    = mu,
  sigma = sigma
)

# QA: confirm clock parameterization reproduces glmnet predictions on a few GTEx samples
enet_model <- clock_results$enet_model
lam <- clock_results$tuning$best_lambda

set.seed(params$seed + 1)
ix <- sample(seq_len(nrow(X_gtex)), size = min(10, nrow(X_gtex)))
pred_glmnet <- as.numeric(predict(enet_model, newx = X_gtex[ix, , drop = FALSE], s = lam))

Z <- sweep(sweep(X_gtex[ix, , drop = FALSE], 2, mu, "-"), 2, sigma, "/")
pred_cs <- alpha_cs + as.numeric(Z %*% beta_cs)

vcat("ClockSHAP clock QA: max |pred_glmnet - pred_cs| = ", signif(max(abs(pred_glmnet - pred_cs)), 6))
```

## Fit GTEx age-conditioned `reference_profile` (ClockSHAP API)

```{r}
reference <- fit_reference_profile(
  features = as.data.frame(X_gtex),
  age      = age_gtex
)
```

## Compute ClockSHAP (TCGA-PT, optional NAT)

```{r}
# --- PT: drop missing ages (ClockSHAP requires complete age) ---
ok_pt <- is.finite(age_pt)
X_pt_cs   <- X_pt[ok_pt, , drop = FALSE]
age_pt_cs <- age_pt[ok_pt]

# ClockSHAP requires `age` to be named by the same sample IDs as `features`
age_pt_cs <- as.numeric(age_pt_cs)
names(age_pt_cs) <- rownames(X_pt_cs)
stopifnot(identical(names(age_pt_cs), rownames(X_pt_cs)))

cs_pt <- clockshap(
  features  = X_pt_cs,
  age       = age_pt_cs,
  clock     = clock,
  reference = reference
)

# --- NAT: only if enough samples AND drop missing ages ---
cs_nt <- NULL
if (has_nat) {
  ok_nt <- is.finite(age_nt)
  X_nt_cs   <- X_nt[ok_nt, , drop = FALSE]
  age_nt_cs <- age_nt[ok_nt]

  # ClockSHAP requires `age` to be named by the same sample IDs as `features`
  age_nt_cs <- as.numeric(age_nt_cs)
  names(age_nt_cs) <- rownames(X_nt_cs)
  stopifnot(identical(names(age_nt_cs), rownames(X_nt_cs)))

  if (nrow(X_nt_cs) >= params$min_nat) {
    cs_nt <- clockshap(
      features  = X_nt_cs,
      age       = age_nt_cs,
      clock     = clock,
      reference = reference
    )
  } else {
    vcat("Skipping NAT ClockSHAP after age-filter: n=", nrow(X_nt_cs), " < min_nat=", params$min_nat)
  }
}
```

## Quick invariant check (optional QA)

```{r}
max_abs_err <- max(abs(rowSums(cs_pt$phi) - cs_pt$deviation), na.rm = TRUE)
vcat("ClockSHAP invariant (PT): max |rowSums(phi) - deviation| = ", signif(max_abs_err, 6))
```

## Quick demo outputs (tables + plots)

### 1) What did we compute?

```{r}
vcat(
  "ClockSHAP outputs (PT): ",
  "phi dim = ", paste(dim(cs_pt$phi), collapse=" x "),
  " | deviation n = ", length(cs_pt$deviation),
  " | expected n = ", length(cs_pt$expected),
  " | pred n = ", length(cs_pt$pred)
)
```

### 2) Deviation distribution

```{r}
# Use phi rownames as authoritative sample IDs
sid <- rownames(cs_pt$phi)
stopifnot(length(cs_pt$deviation) == length(sid))

dev_df <- tibble(
  sample_id = sid,
  deviation = as.numeric(cs_pt$deviation)
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(deviation))

ggplot(dev_df, aes(x = deviation)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("ClockSHAP deviation (PT): ", analysis_id),
    x = "Deviation = predicted − expected (years)",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

### 3) Cohort-level summary: most influential pathways across tumors

```{r}
phi_mat <- cs_pt$phi  # samples x features

phi_summary <- tibble(
  feature = colnames(phi_mat),
  mean_phi = colMeans(phi_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_abs_phi = colMeans(abs(phi_mat), na.rm = TRUE),
  sd_phi = apply(phi_mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
) %>% arrange(desc(mean_abs_phi))

reactable_pretty(phi_summary %>% slice_head(n = 25))
```

## Waterfall Plot (random sample)

```{r}
if (isTRUE(params$do_one_waterfall)) {
  # Choose a random tumour sample (not the most deviated)
  set.seed(params$seed + 2)
  sample_id_wf <- sample(rownames(cs_pt$phi), size = 1)

  vcat("Waterfall sample (random): ", sample_id_wf)

  p_wf <- plot_clockshap_waterfall(
    x       = cs_pt,
    sample  = sample_id_wf,
    top_n   = params$waterfall_top_k,
    show_age_labels   = TRUE,
    show_delta_label  = TRUE,
    show_effect_labels = TRUE
  )

  print(p_wf)
}
```

## Save outputs for downstream analyses

```{r}
out <- list(
  analysis_id = analysis_id,
  clock       = clock,
  reference   = reference,
  pt          = cs_pt,
  nat         = cs_nt,
  demo = list(
    deviation_table = dev_df,
    phi_summary = phi_summary
  )
)

saveRDS(out, file.path(proc_dir, paste0("clockshap_objects", suffix, ".rds")))
vcat("Saved: ", file.path(proc_dir, paste0("clockshap_objects", suffix, ".rds")))
```
